title: Get shredded quick upper body edition
author: Reee C.
desc: To aid in helping you get shredded quick. You may want to add other exercises. I run 11 miles so I don’t do legs. This is full upper body

ex.note: I start every lift with push ups. Usually 3 sets of 40 to warm up. Tailor to your size and weight the goals to warm up not push yourself
The goal is to ease into it.example: I start with 65 lbs then 75 then 85 for the finale 2 sets
This is what we call a burnout. You’ll feel why it’s called that. I start at 65 lbs, 95, 115, 135, 155 and 185 to finish. Adjust to strength
120 more
You’re almost done, it’s that fast! Remember to take a 24 hour break after every lift. You might need more time depending on your body. Lifting to early stunts muscle growth
More push ups to get the blood pumping. These will feel easier by the week if you’re doing it right!
Time to build wrist strength. It’s not as fun but it’s important for bulk. I do the same weight for every set. You should feel a strong burn
The goal is to shape your triceps. You want a very close grip that doesn’t make the bar feel unstable I do 115, 135, 135, 155 and 155 to end. You should barely manage the last set
This time try to have wrist curl form but actually curl the bar. Like a backwards grip. It will be uncomfortable but build huge mass. Do slow reps (5 seconds going up) with light weight
Here you want to do close grip push ups. You want to form a diamond shape with your hands. If you struggle you can lift very light weight on the bench press with a close grip instead
